buy.item: Balanced liquid houseplant fertiliser, roughly NPK 3-1-2 to 10-10-10 (any general indoor plant liquid feed), 500 ml-1 L
buy.why: One feed covers all 14 plants at half strength during the warm season (Oct-Mar). Use quarter strength on the Haworthias and snake plant if you want to be cautious. A separate cactus feed isn't needed.

buy.item: Quality peat-free indoor potting mix, 25-30 L bag (buy 2 if repotting several plants)
buy.why: Base for every mix. Blend with perlite/bark to suit each plant, so no specialist mixes are needed.

buy.item: Plastic nursery/liner pots with drainage holes, 15 cm, 20 cm and 22 cm (a few of each)

Adds chunk for the aroids and ficus. Optional for the Calathea, where a little coco coir or bark helps.

tips: Check drainage on Wednesday: lift each plant out of its ceramic pot and look for holes. Do the feeding and any repotting on the following Saturday.
Feed every 2-4 weeks through the warm season at half strength, only into moist soil, and stop in autumn-winter (April onwards).
Make up the potting mix in one bucket batch and adjust perlite ratios per plant; only repot plants that are root-bound or in non-draining pots.
